title: $n$-strand braid group, Markov closure, and Hecke quadratic quotient: axiomatic framework generalising the 2-strand $\mathbf{B}_2$ foundation and 3-strand typed-$\mathbf{B}_3$ infrastructure
html:
Remark. n-strand braid group, Markov closure, and Hecke quadratic quotient: axiomatic framework generalising the 2-strand \mathbf{B}_2 foundation and 3-strand typed-\mathbf{B}_3 infrastructure

To compute the \mathrm{tr}_M(K_1 \sqcup K_2) inter-knot decoupling, the B_3 framework generalises to arbitrary n-strand braid groups and Hecke quotients. The Lean class system enables per-n extensibility, allowing downstream theorems to auto-specialise as higher dimensions are analysed.
